input.prompt: From this Allstate 10-K text, find every passage describing the Series A 6.500% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Junior Subordinated Debentures due 2067 (and any other junior subordinated debentures). Quote the terms as stated: principal amount, issue date, scheduled maturity, final maturity, interest rate and reset terms (fixed period, floating benchmark, spread), interest payment dates, optional redemption/call dates and prices, interest deferral rights and limits (years, compounding), alternative payment mechanism (common stock issuance), dividend/distribution restrictions during deferral, ranking/seniority wording, replacement capital covenant, and any ratings or exchange listing. Include the section name and any amounts and dates exactly. Text: {{all10k}}

calls.output:
I found the passages on the Series A 6.500% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Junior Subordinated Debentures due 2067 in the Note 14 (Capital Structure) section, plus the cover page and debt table references. The filing contains only one series of junior subordinated debentures. The "Subordinated Debentures" (the $500 million and $800 million Floating Rate Subordinated Debentures due 2053) are not junior subordinated debentures, so I've included them only where the text links them to the junior debentures' covenants.

**1. Cover page (Securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b))**
The cover lists the 5.100% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Debentures due 2053 (NYSE, ALL.PR.B) but does **not** list the 6.500% Junior Subordinated Debentures due 2067 among the registered securities. No exchange listing is stated for the 2067 debentures.

**2. Note 14, Capital Structure – Total debt outstanding table**
- "6.500% Junior Subordinated Debentures, due 2067 — $500 (2024) / $500 (2023)" (in millions), included in "Due after ten years."

**3. Note 14, Capital Structure – Junior Subordinated Debentures (verbatim)**

> "As of December 31, 2024, the Company had outstanding $500 million of Series A 6.500% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Junior Subordinated Debentures ('Junior Subordinated Debentures'). The scheduled maturity date for the Debentures is May 15, 2057 with a final maturity date of May 15, 2067. The Junior Subordinated Debentures may be redeemed (i) in whole or in part, at any time on or after May 15, 2037 at the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest to the date of redemption, or (ii) in certain circumstances, in whole or in part, prior to May 15, 2037 at the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest to the date of redemption or, if greater, a make-whole price."

> "Interest on the Junior Subordinated Debentures is payable semi-annually at the stated fixed annual rate to May 15, 2037, and then payable quarterly at an annual rate equal to the three-month LIBOR plus 2.120%, which was replaced with the CME Term SOFR Reference Rate published for a three-month tenor plus a spread adjustment of 0.26161%."

> "The Company may elect at one or more times to defer payment of interest on the Junior Subordinated Debentures for one or more consecutive interest periods that do not exceed 10 years. Interest compounds during such deferral periods at the rate in effect for each period. The interest deferral feature obligates the Company in certain circumstances to issue common stock or certain other types of securities if it cannot otherwise raise sufficient funds to make the required interest payments. The Company has reserved 75 million shares of its authorized and unissued common stock to satisfy this obligation."

> "The terms of the Subordinated Debentures and Junior Subordinated Debentures prohibit the Company from declaring or paying any dividends or distributions on common or preferred stock or redeeming, purchasing, acquiring, or making liquidation payments on common stock or preferred stock if the Company has elected to defer interest payments on the Subordinated Debentures or Junior Subordinated Debentures, respectively, subject to certain limited exceptions."

> "In connection with the issuance of the Junior Subordinated Debentures, the Company entered into a replacement capital covenant ('RCC'). This covenant was not intended for the benefit of the holders of the Junior Subordinated Debentures and could not be enforced by them. Rather, it was for the benefit of holders of one or more other designated series of the Company's indebtedness ('covered debt'), currently the $800 million Floating Rate Subordinated Debentures due in 2053. Pursuant to the RCC, the Company has agreed that it will not repay, redeem, or purchase the Junior Subordinated Debentures on or before May 15, 2067 (or such earlier date on which the RCC terminates by its terms) unless, subject to certain limitations, the Company has received net cash proceeds in specified amounts from the sale of common stock or certain other qualifying securities. The promises and covenants contained in the RCC will not apply if (i) S&P upgrades the Company's issuer credit rating to A or above, (ii) the Company redeems the Junior Subordinated Debentures due to a tax event, (iii) after notice of redemption has been given by the Company and a market disruption event occurs preventing the Company from raising proceeds in accordance with the RCC, or (iv) the Company repurchases or redeems up to 10% of the outstanding principal of the Junior Subordinated Debentures in any one-year period, provided that no more than 25% will be so repurchased, redeemed or purchased in any ten-year period."

> "The RCC terminates in 2067. The RCC will terminate prior to its scheduled termination date if (i) the Junior Subordinated Debentures are no longer outstanding and the Company has fulfilled its obligations under the RCC or it is no longer applicable, (ii) the holders of a majority of the then-outstanding principal amount of the then-effective series of covered debt consent to agree to the termination of the RCC, (iii) the Company does not have any series of outstanding debt that is eligible to be treated as covered debt under the RCC, (iv) the Junior Subordinated Debentures are accelerated as a result of an event of default, (v) certain rating agency or change in control events occur, (vi) S&P, or any successor thereto, no longer assigns a solicited rating on senior debt issued or guaranteed by the Company, or (vii) the termination of the RCC would have no effect on the equity credit provided by S&P with respect to the Junior Subordinated Debentures. An event of default, as defined by the supplemental indenture, includes default in the payment of interest or principal and bankruptcy proceedings."

**4. Note 14 – Debt maturities and other disclosures**
- The debt maturity table places the $500 million junior debentures in "Thereafter" (no separate date given beyond the 2057/2067 dates above).
- "In 2024, we did not defer interest payments on the subordinated debentures." (MD&A, Capital Resources and Liquidity)

**5. MD&A, Capital Resources and Liquidity – Dividend restriction**
> "The terms of our outstanding subordinated debentures also prohibit us from declaring or paying any dividends or distributions on our common or preferred stock or redeeming, purchasing, acquiring, or making liquidation payments on our common stock or preferred stock if we have elected to defer interest payments on the subordinated debentures, subject to certain limited exceptions."

**6. Item 1A, Risk Factors – Dividend restriction**
> "The terms of the outstanding subordinated debentures prohibit us from declaring or paying any dividends or distributions on our common or preferred stock or redeeming, purchasing, acquiring or making liquidation payments on our common stock or preferred stock if we have elected to defer interest payments on the subordinated debentures, subject to certain limited exceptions."

**7. MD&A, Capital Resources and Liquidity – Ratings**
- S&P, Moody's and A.M. Best are described for the Corporation's debt and AIC's insurance financial strength, but the filing gives no separate rating for the junior debentures. The text states: "The preferred stock and subordinated debentures are viewed as having a common equity component by certain rating agencies and are given equity credit up to a pre-determined limit in our capital structure."

**8. Not found in the text**
- Principal amount is given ($500 million); issue date is not stated.
- Ranking/seniority wording specific to the junior debentures (e.g., "subordinate to senior debt") is not present beyond the "junior subordinated" designation.
- Optional redemption prices other than principal plus accrued interest (or make-whole) are not specified.
- No exchange listing for the 2067 debentures appears in the document.

steps.text:
The FY2024 Allstate 10-K describes one series of junior subordinated debentures: $500 million of Series A 6.500% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Junior Subordinated Debentures due 2067. The Note 14 (Capital Structure) text I retrieved sets out these terms.

**Amount and maturity**
- $500 million outstanding as of December 31, 2024. The same amount was outstanding at December 31, 2023.
- Scheduled maturity is May 15, 2057, and final maturity is May 15, 2067.
- The filing does not state an issue date.

**Interest rate and payments**
- Interest is fixed at 6.500% and paid semi-annually until May 15, 2037.
- After May 15, 2037, interest is paid quarterly at a floating rate. The filing says the original benchmark was three-month LIBOR plus 2.120%, which was replaced with CME Term SOFR for a three-month tenor plus a 0.26161% spread adjustment. The combined spread over Term SOFR is therefore 2.38161% (2.120% + 0.26161%), which is my arithmetic from the stated figures.

**Redemption**
- Redeemable in whole or in part at any time on or after May 15, 2037, at principal plus accrued and unpaid interest.
- Before May 15, 2037, redeemable in certain circumstances at principal plus accrued and unpaid interest or, if greater, a make-whole price.

**Interest deferral and share issuance**
- The Company may defer interest for one or more consecutive periods, not exceeding 10 years in total per deferral.
- Deferred interest compounds at the rate in effect for each period.
- If the Company cannot otherwise raise sufficient funds for required interest payments, it may have to issue common stock or certain other securities. The Company has reserved 75 million authorized but unissued common shares for this obligation.

**Dividend and distribution restrictions**
- While interest is deferred, the Company may not declare or pay dividends or distributions on common or preferred stock, or redeem, buy back, or make liquidation payments on those stock classes, subject to limited exceptions. The same restriction appears in the MD&A and Risk Factors.

**Replacement capital covenant (RCC)**
- The Company entered into an RCC when it issued these debentures. The covenant benefits holders of the $800 million Floating Rate Subordinated Debentures due 2053 (the "covered debt"). It does not benefit the junior debenture holders, who cannot enforce it.
- Under the RCC, the Company will not repay, redeem, or purchase the junior debentures on or before May 15, 2067 unless it has received specified net cash proceeds from qualifying securities sales, subject to limitations.
- The RCC does not apply if S&P upgrades the Company's issuer credit rating to A or above, if the debentures are redeemed due to a tax event, after a market disruption event prevents the Company from raising proceeds under the RCC, or for repurchases or redemptions of up to 10% of principal in any one-year period (capped at 25% in any ten-year period).
- The RCC terminates in 2067 and may end earlier under specified events, including an event of default that accelerates the debentures.

**Not stated in the filing**
- Seniority wording specific to these debentures beyond the "junior subordinated" label.
- Any exchange listing for the 2067 debentures. The cover page lists only the 5.100% Subordinated Debentures due 2053.
- Any separate credit rating for the junior debentures.

As of FY2024, Allstate's capital structure includes one series of junior subordinated debentures: $500 million of Series A 6.500% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Junior Subordinated Debentures due 2067 (Note 14, Capital Structure, FY2024 10-K).

Amount and maturity: $500 million outstanding at Dec 31, 2024 (same at Dec 31, 2023). Scheduled maturity May 15, 2057; final maturity May 15, 2067. Issue date not stated.

Interest: Fixed 6.500%, paid semi-annually until May 15, 2037. Thereafter floating, paid quarterly. The filing states the floating rate was three-month LIBOR + 2.120%, replaced with CME Term SOFR (three-month tenor) + 0.26161% spread adjustment. Combined spread over Term SOFR = 2.38161% (my arithmetic).

Redemption: Redeemable in whole or part at any time on or after May 15, 2037 at principal plus accrued unpaid interest. Before that date, redeemable in certain circumstances at principal plus accrued interest or, if greater, a make-whole price.

Deferral: Company may defer interest for consecutive periods not exceeding 10 years; deferred interest compounds at the applicable rate. If it cannot otherwise raise funds, it may have to issue common stock or other securities; 75 million authorized but unissued common shares are reserved for this.

Dividend restrictions: While interest is deferred, no dividends/distributions on common or preferred stock and no redemption/purchase/liquidation payments on those stock classes, subject to limited exceptions.

Replacement capital covenant: Benefits holders of the $800 million Floating Rate Subordinated Debentures due 2053 (covered debt), not junior debenture holders, who cannot enforce it. Company will not repay, redeem, or purchase the junior debentures on or before May 15, 2067 unless it receives specified net cash proceeds from qualifying securities sales, subject to limits. RCC does not apply if S&P upgrades the issuer rating to A or above, on a tax-event redemption, after a market disruption event, or for repurchases/redemptions of up to 10% of principal per year (25% cap per ten years). RCC terminates in 2067, or earlier under listed events.

Not stated in filing: debenture-specific seniority wording beyond the "junior subordinated" label; exchange listing for the 2067 debentures (cover page lists only the 5.100% Subordinated Debentures due 2053); separate credit rating for the junior debentures.

Source: Allstate Corporation FY2024 Form 10-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/899051/000089905125000015/all-20241231.htm
